member.name: T:bolt.module.copilot.CliAgentRichComponents
member.summary:
Emits the rich solution parts for a CliCopilot layered workspace beyond the root bot shard.
A rich CliCopilot agent's solution carries tool botcomponents, knowledge-source botcomponents, file-attachment botcomponents, skill botcomponents, connected-agent botcomponents, connection references, cloud flows, and the link sets between them.
Component metadata comes from the typed ObjectModel definition read by Copilot.Sync. Component DATA bodies and file payload paths are resolved through the public Copilot.Sync CliCopilot projection seam so local authored edits are reflected.
KNOWN GAPS (clone limitations, not converter limitations): - File-attachment CONTENT is not stored in the clone workspace (only metadata), so the filedata/ payload cannot be reproduced; the botcomponent is emitted metadata-only with a warning. - A connected agent's own bot shard is a cross-agent dependency that does not live in this agent's workspace; it is declared in dependencies.json and must already exist in the target environment (as the export's --AddRequiredComponents otherwise pulls it in).
